premises.text: After major wildfires, insurers stop writing near wildfire areas because third-party wildfire models are inaccurate and cannot separate low-risk from high-risk homes
premises.evidence_span: insurance companies came to realize that the third-party data models, the wildfire models that they were buying, were incredibly inaccurate

premises.text: Proprietary AI wildfire risk models outperform industry models to identify and price low-risk homes inside catastrophe regions (wildfire first, hurricane next)
premises.evidence_span: we have created our own proprietary wildfire models that vastly outperform the models that are available in the industry

premises.text: Policies include active monthly risk-mitigation outreach telling homeowners how risk changed and what to fix
premises.evidence_span: our policy comes along with an active risk mitigation service. We reach out to every homeowner once a month

premises.text: MGA writes policies sold through independent agents while carriers pay claims; also sells analytics side product to other insurers
premises.evidence_span: We're launching as a Managing General Agent, or MGA

value.text: Profitable property insurance for lower-risk homes in catastrophe regions that others avoid
